# Opportunities

I'm recruiting a PhD student to begin fall 2027. If you're interested, please reach out to me by email. You can apply to the Atmsospheric Science graduate program at the University of Utah <a href="https://atmos.utah.edu/graduate/graduate-prospective.php">here</a>. If you can, I highly recommend prospective graduate students apply for the <a href="https://www.nsf.gov/funding/initiatives/grfpNSF">Graduate Research Fellowship</a>. An undergraduate degree in a relevant field (e.g. Atmospheric Science, Physics, Math, Computer Science, Engineering) and an excitement for climate science are required.
